title: Tea
quote: Sharing tea with a fascinating stranger is one of life's true delights.
intro:
The idea of having tea / coffee with strangers came from ***“[Avatar: The Last Airbender S2E8](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W2ONjMIjMoo)”*** .

Then I found [Will Berry](https://www.linkedin.com/in/will-berry/) from TEDx Newy is already doing it. So I had a coffee with him, and he encouraged me to do this as well.

![](/uploads/tea/hark-coffee-with-will-berry.jpeg "Having a coffee with \"Will Berry\" at The Press Book House, Hunter St.")

teas.name: Weekday tea or coffee
teas.where: Mon to Friday. The Press Book House, Ante Meridiem, or suggest your favourite cafe in the CBD.

teas.name: Saturday tea or coffee
teas.where: Mills Place in Adamstown, The Press Book House, or suggest one.

faq:
Tea / coffee is on me.

It will be a relaxed conversation on random things, so no need to be stressed at all.

Any questions, message me on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/talesofhark) or [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/talesofhark).
